description: Na₃P₆N₁₁ crystallizes in the cubic P2_13 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six N atoms. There are three shorter (2.48 Å) and three longer (2.84 Å) Na-N bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two N atoms. Both Na-N bond lengths are 2.87 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six N atoms. There are three shorter (2.46 Å) and three longer (2.73 Å) Na-N bond lengths. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four N atoms to form corner-sharing PN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of P-N bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.74 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four N atoms to form corner-sharing PN₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of P-N bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.74 Å. There are five inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and three equivalent P atoms. In the second N site, N is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two P atoms. In the third N site, N is bonded in a water-like geometry to two P atoms. In the fourth N site, N is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and three equivalent P atoms. In the fifth N site, N is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two P atoms.
